scope: Personal authenticated research reading. Public evidence only; no account IDs, credentials, private bodies or user judgments.

reader.scope: Local Chromium, real UI/SDK/scoped IndexedDB; synthetic Auth/feed/PNG and intercepted explicit original popup. No production data, publisher fetch, Apple device or usefulness claim.

privateReader.scope: Synthetic owner API/metadata/text, real application/SDK and isolated Chromium contexts. Not operating SQL/RLS, physical devices, Apple or recommendation usefulness.

existingDiscovery.scope: Real local app/Core/SDK/IndexedDB and checked-in public catalogue; synthetic edge HTTP and publisher popup interception identified per check. No live OAuth/account/publisher, model inference, Apple hardware or user usefulness validation.

pwa.scope: Real Chromium SDK/IndexedDB/Service Worker. Only the selected exact v167 sw.js is prior code; all app modules and approved-source policy are current. Virtual folders, annual plans, reactions and five-language settings are seeded through the current real scoped storage API before the worker update; an actual a0eac63 v3 historical reading row is seeded unchanged into synthetic local metadata under its original workspace ID. This isolates worker/cache migration rather than reconstructing the entire previous app. Real prepared public catalog served by an anonymous local fixture; synthetic title/build-time update for freshness tests. Mocked Auth response during cached-shell reload is separate from strict offline Auth refusal. No production, Apple device, upstream collection or model validation.

postgres.scope: Synthetic PostgreSQL 17 with Auth schema shims, three real sessions. No hosted project, user data or credentials.

hosted.scope: Hosted Edge/Auth/database with configured synthetic A/B accounts and public publisher content. No personal account data queried.

hostedResponseUI.scope: Actual hosted Auth/Edge/database response from a configured test account; exact response displayed with synthetic Auth in current local Chromium UI at 1440px and 390px. Not real-account UI end-to-end or physical Apple hardware.

integratedInstallation.scope: Agent-verified disposable PostgreSQL 17 before environment disconnect: exact migration allowlist, atomic rollback, existing rows/functions/privileges and populated private cache reinstallation. Final restored commit must pass GitHub CI separately.
